case.believed: Babel 7.27.4 already parses dynamic import() as ImportExpression by default because that is the standards-shaped AST used by Babel 8.
contract: Babel 7.27.4 parseSync represents dynamic import as a CallExpression with an Import callee by default
types.isImportExpression rejects the default Babel 7 node while types.isImport accepts its callee
parserOpts.createImportExpressions true produces an ImportExpression with a source property
the opt-in ImportExpression has neither callee nor arguments properties
case.goal: Handle the Babel 7.27.4 dynamic import AST shape before migrating visitors to Babel 8
